_meta.scope: Prominent figures modified or reviewed in the 2026-11 gap-closure PR. Not a full inventory of every number on the site.
_meta.verification_note: 'Checked against' names the committed file a figure was compared with. Upstream publisher pages could not be fetched from the review environment (egress proxy), so upstream values were not re-read; the committed ingests and their recorded download URLs are the evidence.

claims.claim: 40% of Michigan households were below the ALICE Threshold in 2024 (39.7% unrounded): 13% in poverty and 26% above poverty but unable to afford basics.
claims.source: United For ALICE, Michigan Data Sheet 2026 (2024 data)
claims.methodology: ALICE Threshold = household survival budget by county and household type; below-threshold = poverty + ALICE households.
claims.change: Insight and quiz said households below the threshold 'earn too much for aid', which describes only the ALICE (above-poverty) group, not the 40%. Reworded. The historical 41% statewide figure is gone from rendered copy (only a code comment documents it).
claims.qualification: ALICE is a modeled threshold. United For ALICE rounds 39.7% to 40%.

claims.claim: Highest county below the ALICE Threshold: Clare, 55.4%.
claims.source: United For ALICE, Michigan Data Sheet 2026 (2024 data)
claims.methodology: Maximum of belowAliceThresholdPct across county records.
claims.change: Previously 'Lake Co., 64% below ALICE' (an older report's figure; Lake is 51.5% in the 2026 sheet and not the highest). Survival budget corrected from $27,156 to $29,580 (single adult).
claims.qualification: No published uncertainty range; small-county estimates are less stable.

claims.claim: Removed: 'Rural Michigan counties have 7x fewer PCPs per capita than urban counties; rural residents travel 3x further'; data points 1:3,200 vs 1:460, 42 mi, 47 of 83.
claims.source: Cited 'HRSA HPSA data + County Health Rankings 2025' with no dataset, rural definition or computation in the repo.
claims.change: Withheld. Replaced with a figure computed from the committed HRSA rollup (next entry).
claims.qualification: Could be restored only with a named rurality definition (e.g. RUCC/RUCA), a primary-care ratio source and vintage, and a reproducible computation.

claims.claim: 79 of Michigan's 83 counties contain at least one designated primary care HPSA; none in Antrim, Clinton, Livingston, Midland.
claims.source: HRSA HPSA Primary Care facility detail file (BCD_HPSA_FCT_DET_PC.csv)
claims.geography: Michigan counties (83); HPSAs themselves are often sub-county
claims.methodology: County rollup of designated-status records by AccessMI (scripts/refresh-hrsa-hpsa-county.mjs).
claims.qualification: A county containing an HPSA does not mean the whole county is a shortage area.

claims.claim: Civic Insight Score (0-100) on county briefs and the downloadable brief.
claims.source: AccessMI threshold score from County Health Rankings 2025 inputs (SAHIE 2022 uninsured; Map the Meal Gap 2022 food insecurity) and county type
claims.methodology: Base 60 plus fixed points per threshold, clamped 10-95 (CIVIC_SCORE_METHODOLOGY).
claims.change: The breakdown panel and the PDF/HTML brief described a different 40/60 model (z-score vulnerability + 'Access Friction'). Its composite did not equal the displayed score, counted outages as 0 with no feed, scored missing Supabase counts as best case, inverted the primary-care ratio, and attributed CHR inputs to 'Census ACS'. Both now show the real inputs and points; missing inputs are flagged.
claims.qualification: No uncertainty range. Comparison aid only.

claims.claim: Michigan county poverty and median household income, /data/michigan-county-income-poverty.json
claims.source: U.S. Census Bureau SAIPE, 2024 state and county estimates
claims.publication_year_note: Year of release inferred from estimate year 2024; the file records ingested_at 2026-11-03, not the release date.
claims.denominator: SAIPE poverty universe per measure (see Census SAIPE methodology)
claims.uncertainty: 90% bounds for povertyPct, childPovertyPct, medianHouseholdIncome; none in file for schoolAgePovertyPct
claims.change: Unchanged values. Added JSON Schema, data-index entry with comparability rules, and agent-consumer tests (overlapping intervals refuse a ranking).

claims.checked_against: check-data-catalog.mjs output: 32 catalog entries against 52 feeds from 42 publishers
claims.change: None. The 2026-11-19 note that Lovable showed an 'older 52-source catalog' is not a discrepancy: the current catalog also has 52 feeds, and the Lovable project tracks main (latest_commit_sha 423b294).

claims.claim: Verified health facilities in Michigan (CMS hospitals + HRSA active service sites)

claims.qualification: Main's snapshot is about 10 weeks old; the facility-refresh workflow failed at install from 2026-11-09 to this fix.
